criteria.name: cue-noticed
criteria.evidence: The operator remarked on the anomalous feature before being prompted.

criteria.name: event-named
criteria.evidence: The classification given matches an accepted answer for this item.

criteria.name: first-action-named
criteria.evidence: The first action given matches an accepted first action for the governing procedure.

criteria.name: physics-plausible
criteria.evidence: Any quantitative judgement offered is consistent with orbital mechanics and the platform class.

criteria.name: confidence-calibrated
criteria.evidence: Stated confidence matched the outcome, scored by a proper scoring rule.

criteria.name: report-content
criteria.evidence: The reported content covers the procedure's reporting requirements.
